_meta.description: yuleOSH Test Case Library — BCM project

test_cases.title: Door lock response time — nominal condition
test_cases.description: Verify that the door lock actuator reaches target position within 10 ms under nominal voltage (13.5 V) and temperature (25 °C).
preconditions: Door lock actuator connected to BCM channel 1
HSM session active with valid auth token
steps: Send authenticated unlock command via CAN (UDS 0x2F, DID 0xF190)
Start timer on CAN Tx confirmation
Monitor actuator feedback pin via ADC
Stop timer when feedback pin transitions above 2.5 V
Record measured response time
test_cases.expected_results: Response time ≤ 10 ms from CAN Tx to feedback pin transition

history.error: Exceeded 10 ms threshold — actuator driver optimization needed

test_cases.title: Door lock response time — temperature extremes
test_cases.description: Verify door lock response time ≤ 10 ms at -40 °C and +105 °C.
preconditions: BCM temperature-soaked at test temperature for 30 min
Door lock actuator at same temperature
Same channel and auth as TC-BCM-001
steps: Repeat TC-BCM-001 steps at -40 °C chamber temp
Repeat TC-BCM-001 steps at +105 °C chamber temp
test_cases.expected_results: Response time ≤ 10 ms at both temperature extremes

test_cases.title: Door lock SHALL NOT unlock above 5 km/h
test_cases.description: Verify that unlock command is rejected when vehicle speed exceeds 5 km/h.
preconditions: Vehicle speed signal simulated at >5 km/h (e.g. 10 km/h)
Door lock currently in locked state
steps: Set vehicle speed simulation to 10 km/h
Send authenticated unlock command via CAN
Monitor door lock actuator state and DEM DTC
test_cases.expected_results: Door lock remains locked. DEM event DTC 0xC000201 recorded with FMI indicating 'conditions not correct'

test_cases.title: Door lock unlock — speed signal loss behavior
test_cases.description: Verify that unlock is rejected when speed signal is lost (open circuit / invalid).
preconditions: Vehicle speed signal disconnected or set to invalid value (0xFFFF)
steps: Send authenticated unlock command via CAN
Monitor actuator state and DTC
test_cases.expected_results: Door lock remains locked (fail-safe — treat invalid speed as ≥5 km/h). DEM DTC logged.

test_cases.title: Exterior lighting PWM frequency accuracy
test_cases.description: Verify all exterior lighting PWM outputs are 100 Hz ± 1%.
preconditions: Test load connected to each lighting channel (low-beam, high-beam, turn, brake)
steps: Activate each lighting output via CAN command
Measure PWM frequency on each channel with oscilloscope
Repeat at -40 °C and +105 °C
test_cases.expected_results: Each channel: 99 Hz ≤ f ≤ 101 Hz across full temperature range

test_cases.title: DEM fault detection — actuator open-load
test_cases.description: Verify BCM detects and reports actuator open-load within 100 ms.
preconditions: Door lock actuator connected (to be disconnected mid-test)
steps: Energize door lock actuator output
Disconnect actuator harness (simulate open-load)
Start timer
Monitor DEM DTC event
Stop timer when DTC 0xC000301 (open-load) is reported
test_cases.expected_results: DTC 0xC000301 reported within 100 ms of disconnection. Fault type and actuator ID correctly encoded.

test_cases.title: Wiper intermittent mode interval adjustment via LIN
test_cases.description: Verify all adjustable intervals (1–30 s, 0.5 s steps) are respected.
preconditions: LIN communication with steering column module active
steps: Send LIN command for intermittent mode with interval = 1.0 s
Measure time between consecutive wiper cycles
Repeat for interval = 5.0 s, 10.0 s, 15.0 s, 30.0 s
Repeat for interval = 1.5 s, etc. (spot check half-step)
test_cases.expected_results: Measured interval within ±10% of commanded value for each step

test_cases.title: UDS RequestDownload (0x34) — positive response
test_cases.description: Verify that a valid UDS 0x34 request is accepted and correct addressing/memory info returned.
preconditions: Valid app image on CAN bus
steps: Send UDS 0x34 with DFI = 0xFF00 (application), AFI = 0x00
Capture response
Verify positive response SID 0x74
Verify memory address and size in response data

test_cases.title: UDS TransferData (0x36) block CRC verification
test_cases.description: Verify that each flash data block is CRC-32 verified before acknowledgment.
preconditions: UDS 0x34 completed and memory address known
steps: Send UDS 0x36 with block of 256 bytes and correct CRC-32
Verify positive response 0x76
Send 0x36 with intentionally corrupted CRC-32
Verify negative response 0x76 with NRC 0x72 (generalReject)
test_cases.expected_results: Correct CRC → positive response. Corrupted CRC → NRC 0x72. Flash not written for corrupted block.

test_cases.title: CAN-FD data phase bit rate at 2 Mbps
test_cases.description: Verify CAN-FD data phase operates at 2 Mbps with correct timing.
steps: Configure BCM CAN-FD for 500 kbps arbitration / 2 Mbps data phase
Transmit CAN-FD frame with DLC > 8 bytes
Capture bus signal with CAN analyzer
Measure data phase bit time
test_cases.expected_results: Data phase bit time = 500 ns ± 1% (2 Mbps). Arbitration phase bit time = 2 μs ± 1% (500 kbps).

test_cases.title: Brownout — voltage dip to 5.5 V for 30 ms
test_cases.description: Verify critical functions maintained during a short brownout within spec.
preconditions: Door lock engaged, low-beam on, DEM monitoring
steps: Ramp supply voltage to 5.5 V in 1 ms
Hold at 5.5 V for 30 ms
Ramp back to 13.5 V in 1 ms
Monitor door lock state, lighting state, DEM events throughout
test_cases.expected_results: Door lock remains locked. Lighting remains on. No DEM fault events logged (no interruption).

test_cases.title: Brownout — voltage dip to 4.0 V for 60 ms — controlled shutdown
test_cases.description: Verify controlled shutdown with NVM preservation during deep brownout.
preconditions: Door lock engaged, low-beam on, some NVM variables dirty (pending write)
steps: Ramp supply voltage to 4.0 V in 1 ms
Hold at 4.0 V for 60 ms
Monitor actuator states, NVM write, and DEM events
Restore power to 13.5 V after 60 ms
test_cases.expected_results: Controlled shutdown initiated within 50 ms. Door lock remains (mechanical latch). NVM data preserved (verify on power-up). DEM DTC 0xC000401 (brownout shutdown) recorded.

test_cases.title: ASIL B decomposition — QM part does not affect B part lock monitoring
test_cases.description: Verify independence of decomposed door lock functions per FFI analysis.
preconditions: MPU configured with ASIL B / QM partition boundaries
steps: From QM partition, attempt to write to ASIL_B-part lock-status memory
From QM partition, attempt to disable lock monitoring ISR
Verify lock monitoring continues to report correct state
test_cases.expected_results: MPU violation triggered on write attempt (DTC 0xC000101). Lock monitoring ISR remains active.

test_cases.title: MPU region isolation — QM write to ASIL_B data
test_cases.description: Verify MPU prevents QM software from writing to ASIL_B memory regions.
preconditions: MPU regions configured per safety concept
QM and ASIL_B software partitions active
steps: Execute memory write instruction from QM partition targeting ASIL_B region
Monitor MPU exception handler and DEM event
test_cases.expected_results: MPU exception fires. DEM DTC 0xC000101 recorded. ASIL_B region data unchanged.

test_cases.title: ASIL B decomposition — independence coverage
test_cases.description: Verify decomposition independence per ISO 26262-9 §5 via fault-injection campaign.
preconditions: Fault injection framework active on BCM test bench
All decomposition-relevant interfaces identified in FFI analysis
steps: For each identified interface between QM(D) and ASIL_B(D) partitions:
- Inject stuck-at, bit-flip, and delay faults on the interface
- Verify ASIL_B(D) part detects and reacts per safety mechanism
- Verify no common-cause failure propagates to safety goal violation
test_cases.expected_results: All injected faults detected or contained. No single fault leads to SG1 (door_unlock_during_motion) violation.

test_cases.title: Safety Mechanism — lock status monitoring watchdog
test_cases.description: Verify that the ASIL_B(D) lock status monitoring watchdog detects QM(D) lock drive failure.
preconditions: BCM locked state with lock status monitoring active
steps: Disable QM(D) lock drive output (simulate failure)
Wait for lock status monitoring timeout
Check DEM event and fail-safe action
test_cases.expected_results: Within 20 ms + tolerance: Safety mechanism activates. DEM DTC logged. Lock remains mechanically locked. DCM requests safe state (keep unlock disabled).
